package: SOT-23-5 (TI DBV, R-PDSO-G5), body 2.9 mm x 1.6 mm
description: Single 2-input positive-AND gate, 1.65 V to 5.5 V VCC, 5.5 V tolerant inputs, +/-24 mA output drive at 3.3 V (TI SCES217Y, Apr 2014).

pinout.name: A
pinout.notes: Gate input A (DBV/DCK/DRL/YZP column of the Pin Functions table, sec 5).

pinout.name: Y
pinout.notes: Gate output, Y = A AND B.

pinout.name: VCC
pinout.notes: Power pin, 1.65 V to 5.5 V operating.

decoupling.placement: as close to the VCC pin as possible
decoupling.notes: Sec 10 Power Supply Recommendations: single-supply device -> 0.1 uF bypass recommended; 0.1 uF and 1 uF in parallel are commonly used to reject different noise frequencies.

land_pattern.notes: From the DBV LAND PATTERN DATA sheet (drawing 4209593-3/C, 08/11), Example Board Layout: 0.95 mm pad pitch, 1.90 mm between the two pads of the 2-pad row (pins 4 and 5), 2.7 mm between the centerlines of the 3-pad and 2-pad rows. Pad geometry 0.6 mm x 1.05 mm, non-soldermask-defined with solder mask opening 0.07 mm larger all around. Stencil openings 0.55 mm x 1.00 mm at 0.127 mm stencil thickness. IPC-7351 recommended for alternate designs.

layout_notes: Unused inputs must never float: all unused inputs must be held at VCC or GND (Recommended Operating Conditions note 1; sec 11.1 Layout Guidelines).
Bypass: 0.1 uF as close to the VCC pin as possible; 0.1 uF + 1 uF in parallel commonly used (sec 10).
Output drive at 3.3 V (Recommended Operating Conditions, VCC = 3 V): IOH = -24 mA, IOL = 24 mA. Feature list states +/-24 mA output drive at 3.3 V.

Output levels at VCC = 3 V (Electrical Characteristics 6.5): VOH >= 2.4 V at IOH = -16 mA and >= 2.3 V at IOH = -24 mA; VOL <= 0.4 V at IOL = 16 mA and <= 0.55 V at IOL = 24 mA (same limits for -40 to 85 C and -40 to 125 C).
Input thresholds at VCC = 3 V to 3.6 V (Recommended Operating Conditions): VIH min 2 V, VIL max 0.8 V. Inputs accept up to 5.5 V at any valid VCC.

Propagation delay at 3.3 V: sec 6.6 (CL = 15 pF, RL = 1 Mohm, Figure 3) tpd A or B -> Y = 0.8 ns min / 3.6 ns max over -40 to 85 C. Sec 6.8 (CL = 50 pF, RL = 500 ohm, VLOAD = 6 V, VM = 1.5 V, Figure 4) tpd = 1 ns min / 4.5 ns max over -40 to 85 C and 1 ns min / 6 ns max over -40 to 125 C.
Input edge-rate limit: dt/dv <= 10 ns/V at VCC = 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V (Recommended Operating Conditions). Test-circuit input edges are tr/tf <= 2.5 ns at 3.3 V.

The datasheet does NOT specify an output rise/fall (transition) time or slew rate - only tpd is characterized. Sec 9.2.1 warns the high drive creates fast edges into light loads, so routing and load conditions must be considered to prevent ringing.
3.3 V operation is fully specified (dedicated 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V columns in 6.6/6.8 and VCC = 3 V rows in 6.3/6.5). Full supply range 1.65 V to 5.5 V; data retention only down to 1.5 V.
Cpd (power dissipation capacitance) = 26 pF typ at VCC = 3.3 V, f = 10 MHz, TA = 25 C (sec 6.9).
Function table (sec 8.4): Y = H only when A = H and B = H; any input L forces Y = L.
Ci (input capacitance) = 4 pF max at VCC = 3.3 V. Device is Ioff-protected for partial-power-down (outputs disabled when VCC = 0 V).
